title: Separability of global sections of a proper geometrically reduced scheme
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $X$ be a proper scheme over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism] which is geometrically reduced over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Put $A=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and assume that the structure map makes $A/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Then $A/k$ is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension].

source.place: Lemma 0BUG (lemma-proper-geometrically-reduced-global-sections), clause (4): separability of H^0(X,O_X) over k for proper geometrically reduced X

proof.text: By [lem-pc-euler-characteristic-well-defined] with F=O_X and i=0, A=Gamma(X,O_X) is finite-dimensional over k. Together with the assumed field-extension structure, this says that A/k is a finite field extension.

source.place: Lemma 0BUG, proof of clause (1), citing Cohomology of Schemes Lemma Tag 02O6

proof.text: Choose an algebraic closure kbar of k. The map Spec(kbar) -> Spec(k) is flat, and X is quasi-compact and quasi-separated because X is proper over the affine scheme Spec(k). Hence [lem-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-global-sections-qcqs] identifies A tensor_k kbar with Gamma(X_kbar,O_{X_kbar}).

source.place: Lemma 0BUG, proof of clause (4), lines 1980-1984, citing Cohomology of Schemes Lemma Tag 02KH

proof.text: Geometric reducedness means that X_kbar is reduced. A nilpotent global section of a reduced scheme is zero because its image in every stalk is nilpotent and every stalk is reduced; therefore Gamma(X_kbar,O_{X_kbar}) is reduced. By step 2, A tensor_k kbar is reduced.

Apply [lem-pc-finite-extension-tensor-algebraic-closure-reduced-separable] to the finite extension A/k from step 1 and the reduced tensor product from step 3. It follows that A/k is separable, which is the claimed conclusion.
